 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% Main Title
 subgraph 主系统 [\"Investment Research Document Generation Multi-Agent System\"]
 direction TB
 %% Product Manager Agent (topmost)
 subgraph PM [\"Product Manager\nAgent (PM Agent)\"]
 PM1[Task Decomposition / Process Orchestration]
 PM2[Process Acceptance]
 end
 %% Three parallel branches
 subgraph 数据 [\"Data Perception\nAgent\"]
 DS1[Multi-Source Acquisition]
 DS2[Real-Time Cleaning]
 end
 
 subgraph 逻辑 [\"Industry Logic\nAgent\"]
 YL1[Industry Chain Analysis]
 YL2[Business Logic]
 end
 
 subgraph 量化 [\"Quantitative Analysis\nAgent\"]
 QL1[Financial Modeling]
 QL2[Technical Indicators]
 end
 %% Risk Alert Agent
 subgraph 预警 [\"Risk Alert\nAgent\"]
 YJ[Sentiment / Anomaly Event Monitoring]
 end
 %% Document Engineer Agent
 subgraph 文档 [\"Document Engineer\nAgent\"]
 WJ1[Structured Writing]
 WJ2[Chart Generation]
 WJ3[Citation Retrieval]
 WJ4[Stylistic Polish]
 WJ5[Multi-Modal Layout]
 end
 %% Connection Lines (strictly matching original hierarchy and parallel relations)
 PM1 & PM2 -->|Output| DS1 & DS2 & YL1 & YL2 & QL1 & QL2
 DS1 & DS2 & YL1 & YL2 & QL1 & QL2 -->|Output| YJ
 YJ -->|Output| WJ1 & WJ2 & WJ3 & WJ4 & WJ5
 end",
 "config": null
